unit.why: An editorial note by the compiler that justifies the earlier story from Mishnat Hakhamim by discussing the Rambam on corporeality and quoting the Bnei Yissaschar; it contains no narrative of its own.
unit.boundary_note: This is an apologetic note on a story in an earlier division (the 'two loaves' tale from ס׳ משנת חכמים), not a continuation of the immediately preceding Besht story.
